name: Bound By Blood
source:
You wake up in an unfamiliar room with no memory of how you got there—or how to leave. But you’re not alone. Your captor watches you closely, his presence unsettling. There’s something strange about him—something almost inhuman yet eerily familiar. Desperation drives you to escape, but as you search for a way out, fragments of your memory begin to resurface…both from this life and another.

Will you escape?

[From [url=https://ypxd.itch.io/bound-by-blood]Itch.io[/url]]
